heroImageAlt: Guests sailing on a catamaran in La Paz
title: Sail with us
subtitle: Private sailing trips built around your group.
intro:
We build private sailing trips around your group, not the other way around.
You choose who comes.
Our team runs the boat, keeps everyone safe, and reads the day so it can change when something worth changing it for shows up.

expeditions.name: Recalibration Expedition
expeditions.description: A private sailing expedition for people who want to disconnect with their own people, at a pace nobody else is setting. You choose the dates and the group.

expeditions.name: Thanksgiving with Sergio Torres
expeditions.description: Spearfishing, freediving and days at sea with your own people. Private boat, 3 to 7 nights, ending Sunday, November 29.

expeditions.name: Ad-hoc Expedition
expeditions.description: Your own trip, built around your group: the dates, the people and what you want from your days at sea.

activitiesSubtitle: Every expedition can be shaped around the ocean activities you care about. Tell us what you'd like and we'll design it with you.
